name: Diminishment
source:
This is a Shrinking themed visual novel made in Unity, with mildly interactive animated CG videos and quick time events (you press buttons in time & something happens depending on if you succeeded or not). There might be Giantess/Growth in the future, but I'd rather not promise anything at this time, as what is planned is planned for when the game is pretty far a long. The game's main perspective is POV, but there might be 3rd person videos as well occasionally, and some events might have the option of switching views during some points, but all that is extra work, so it's subject to change depending on my workload etc.

The themes are similar to my previous content! So expect vore, and some of the more naughtier stuff. I'll not spoil anything else, in case you'd rather see it for yourself :)

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/eskoz/art/Diminishment-Prologue-VN-w-animated-CGs-760047949]Developer's DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
一款以缩小为主题、使用Unity制作的视觉小说，包含轻度互动的动画CG视频与快速反应事件（按时按键，成功或失败会产生不同结果）。未来或许会加入巨人／成长内容，但目前不作承诺；相关内容要等游戏开发得更完善后才会规划。游戏主要采用主观视角，偶尔也可能出现第三人称视频；部分事件或许能切换视角，但这些都需要额外工作，会根据开发者的工作量调整。

主题与作者此前的作品相似，因此会出现吞食等内容，以及更加下流的情节。其他内容就不剧透了，留给你自行体验。

[来源：[url=https://www.deviantart.com/eskoz/art/Diminishment-Prologue-VN-w-animated-CGs-760047949]开发者DeviantArt页面[/url]]
